subject: [AMBER] How to add KCl cellular concentration.

messages.author: Sayan Poddar
messages.body:
Dear AMBER developers and Users,
I have followed the below mentioned amber tutorial for adding 150 mM of
cellular NaCl concentration.
https://ambermd.org/tutorials/basic/tutorial8/index.php
But I want to add KCl instead of NaCl, so what changes in calculation needs
to be done?

messages.author: Maria Nagan
messages.body:
Hi,
You should figure out what concentration of KCl you want and modify the calculation accordingly (e.g. do you want 200 mM KCl, etc.).
Then when you add ions, use K+ instead of Na+ in the input. <
https://ambermd.org/tutorials/basic/tutorial7/index.php#Use_LEaP_to_Build_a_Protein_System_in_Explicit_Solvent
>
Maria
